points: Your site answers how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping, so buyers have to guess when a bag arrives and scroll on. Open three ads with the delivery window from your shipping policy, aimed at first-time buyers.
Your site shows prices from $65 to $198, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price, so buyers click just to learn the cost. Lead one ad with the $65 piece next to the $198 one, saying what each one is for.
None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a first-time buyer has no count to trust before the click. Take one real figure, a review count or orders shipped, and open two ads with it.

Your 17 copy ads open on 10 different stories, and the biggest, the bag charm line, leads only 3 of them. Pick the two strongest openers, bag charm and duffle in stock, and write the next batch only from them.

ads_1: Delivery and price led bag ads built on the duffle and bag charm openers
